description: This Java class implements the OAuth2 client data access object (DAO) for the Thingsboard platform, providing methods to query and manipulate OAuth2 client data in a SQL database.

classes.name: JpaOAuth2ClientDao
classes.description: Data access object for OAuth2Client entities, providing database operations such as find, delete, and query by various parameters.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the OAuth2ClientEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JPA repository used for OAuth2ClientEntity.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds OAuth2 clients by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEnabledByDomainName
methods.description: Finds enabled OAuth2 clients by domain name for WEB platform.

methods.name: findEnabledByPkgNameAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds enabled OAuth2 clients by package name and platform type (Android or iOS).

methods.name: findByDomainId
methods.description: Finds OAuth2 clients by domain ID.

methods.name: findByMobileAppBundleId
methods.description: Finds OAuth2 clients by mobile app bundle ID.

methods.name: findAppSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the app secret for a given client ID, package name, and platform type.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes OAuth2 clients associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findByIds
methods.description: Finds OAuth2 clients by tenant ID and list of OAuth2ClientId objects.

methods.name: isPropagateToEdge
methods.description: Checks if OAuth2 client propagation to edge is enabled for a tenant.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is OAUTH2_CLIENT.
